description: The plot illustrates the training loss over a number of iterations for various language model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000, with tick marks placed at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The plot contains six solid lines without markers, each surrounded by a lighter shaded region of the corresponding color. All lines exhibit a steep initial decline from a loss value greater than 3.4 near iteration 0, transitioning into a gradual, steady decline across the remainder of the x-axis, with data ending just past the 140,000 iteration mark. The solid blue line, labeled "StrmLLM (n=64)", ends at the highest final loss of approximately 2.61. The solid orange line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64)", ends at approximately 2.52. The solid green line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H)", ends at approximately 2.51. The solid dark blue line, labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", ends at approximately 2.50. The solid red line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", ends at approximately 2.49. Finally, the solid purple line, which corresponds to an obscured grey box in the legend, ends at the lowest final loss of approximately 2.46.
